passages.provision_quote: BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED that the Board strongly opposes any Indiana laws or proposed legislation, including 2023 House Bill 1608, that limit the rights of L@BTQIA+ students and put them at greater risk for discrimination or harassment.
passages.note: Signed board resolution opposing HB 1608 (whose notification/approval requirements are named only in a recital); it shows opposition to mandated notification/permission but states no notification rule of its own, so it does not separate rungs 1-3.

rows.reasoning: Resolution 2023-07, which she signed, "strongly opposes" 2023 House Bill 1608, a bill its recitals say would "require notification to, and approval from, parents when students request name changes and different pronouns"; that points away from "Require schools to notify parents" and "Require parental permission before staff use a different name or pronouns". Its operative clauses set no notification rule, so nothing matches "Require staff to keep a student's gender identity from parents unless the student consents", "Forbid rules that require schools to tell parents", or "Require schools to tell parents when parents ask" — side only.
